derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1110 (γνωστός);

occurrences.text: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
